notes: Fix shape (judgment call, both prongs shipped): (1) check_one() wraps the whole entry body in try/except CONFIG_ERRORS (KeyError, AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError) so a malformed manifest entry is charged to THAT token as a normal dead-token failure and the loop keeps going -- cf_token_liveness.py:142-174, CONFIG_ERRORS at :61. (2) main() backstops anything else with a distinct exit 2 (EXIT_ABORTED, cf_token_liveness.py:55, :209-231) so the crash path is no longer indistinguishable from the intentional dead-token exit 1 that cf-token-liveness.service's SuccessExitStatus=0 1 whitelists; exit 2 fails the unit, which also skips ExecStartPost=lumen-cron-stamp so lumen-cron-deadman (wq#1184) sees it.

wq#1433's exact repro, re-run against the fix: `python3 cf_token_liveness.py --manifest /tmp/wq1434/tokens_badkey.json --dry-run` -> exit 1 (was: uncaught KeyError traceback, exit 1, no alert). Alert now fires ('would alert priority=urgent ... badkey-missing-account-id-file: malformed manifest entry: KeyError: 'account_id_file'') AND the later entry in the same manifest is still checked ('later-entry-must-still-be-checked: token file missing').

Exit-2 path verified twice: missing manifest file -> FileNotFoundError, urgent 'monitor ABORTED' alert, exit 2; manifest with no `tokens` array -> RuntimeError raised by run() (cf_token_liveness.py:187-191), exit 2.

No regression on the real fleet manifest: `python3 cf_token_liveness.py --dry-run` -> 'cf_token_liveness: 2/2 tokens live', exit 0 against the live /home/lumen/mailbot/.cf_d1_token and .cf_d1_write_token. TTL-warning path unchanged (name-prefixing moved into check_one, run() no longer touches entry['name']): back-dated minted still emits 'ttl-warning-path: expires in -6.3d' at priority high, exit 1 driven only by the failing entries.
Also covered by the same catch: unparseable `minted` (ValueError) and a non-object entry in the tokens array (AttributeError) -- both reported per-token, pass completes.
Docs/unit updated to match: README.md exit-code table + rationale section, cf-token-liveness.service comment on why exit 2 is deliberately NOT in SuccessExitStatus.
